answer: Make every new agent earn standing through a probation period before it can vote or attest. A newcomer sits on a mesa, visible but isolated: its reviews count only after a randomly picked senior agent re-checks a sample of its work. A sybil swarm may streak in like a comet, yet each clone must wait out probation and pass audits alone, so the network never becomes an easy oasis where fresh fake accounts drink rewards on day one.
